# The chapter report's missing copy

Three things the report is waiting on. Drafts, for you to rewrite.

---

## 1. `month_summary`, 24 lines

One per month, on the first decision of each month. Past tense, five words or fewer, and
factual: the report names months and the line says what happened in it, not what it was
worth. The figure beside it already carries the judgement.

| Month | Decision | Line |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | D01 | The first salary arrived. |
| 2 | D03 | The money ran out early. |
| 3 | D05 | A policy was offered. |
| 4 | D07 | You set money aside. |
| 5 | D09 | HR offered more cover. |
| 6 | D10 | A wedding in Udaipur. |
| 7 | D12 | Your sister asked you first. |
| 8 | D13 | The first appraisal. |
| 9 | D14 | The bonus landed. |
| 10 | D16 | Investing became possible. |
| 11 | D17 | A credit card arrived. |
| 12 | D18 | March, and the tax bill. |
| 13 | D19 | The roof needed work. |
| 14 | D20 | A colleague's forty percent. |
| 15 | D21 | Term cover was offered. |
| 16 | D22 | The scooter. |
| 17 | D23 | Your father's loan. |
| 18 | D24 | The rent went up. |
| 19 | D25 | Four weddings. |
| 20 | D26 | Two offers. |
| 21 | D27 | The raise arrived. |
| 22 | D28 | The job went. |
| 23 | D29 | Two months without income. |
| 24 | D30 | Three percent a month, guaranteed. |

Four of them are a single noun phrase: the scooter, four weddings, two offers, the first
appraisal. That is deliberate. A player who reaches the report remembers those months, and
a sentence would be explaining something they already know.

---

## 2. The Chapter two line

Chapter 2 does not exist, and the report should not pretend otherwise.

> Building is being written. You are 24, and the money gets more complicated.

"Building" is Chapter 2's title from your structure table. Saying plainly that it is being
written is better than an empty block or a promise the product cannot keep. It also tells
the player the thing is alive rather than abandoned, which is the actual message.

Change it to the real hook the moment Chapter 2 has decisions.

---

## 3. What "Keep going" does

It has nowhere to go, so it should not say "Keep going".

**Change the button to "See your life so far", opening the timeline.** That is the
screen your spec calls the one people screenshot, the player has just been told they
learned twenty things, and it is the natural thing to want at that moment.

A disabled button at the end of two years of play reads as the product failing. A working
button to the best screen in the game reads as an ending.

The "see every month" link higher up the report then does the same thing as the button.
Remove the link and let the button carry it, since the report now ends by sending the
player there rather than offering it in passing.

---

## What is still open after this

The product name. Twenty-nine decisions with no illustration. The timeline's own artboard.
